title: The 4 Best Juicers Under $200
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for juicers under $200, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at juicers under $200 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Breville Juice Fountain Cold
products.blurb: Key specs: 850W motor, Cold Spin Technology, 70oz juice jug.
strengths: Cold Spin Technology limits juice temperature rise, slowing oxidation
Fast, simple operation with an easy rinse-clean design
limitations: Lower yield on leafy greens and celery than a masticating juicer at a similar or lower sale price
Bulkier footprint than compact upright masticating juicers

products.name: Omega J8006HDS Masticating Juicer
products.blurb: Key specs: 80 RPM dual-stage auger, 200W motor, 37oz juice container.
strengths: Noticeably better yield on greens, celery, and fibrous produce than any centrifugal juicer near this price
15-year warranty is the longest in the category at any price
limitations: Slower processing pace than a centrifugal juicer
Smaller pulp and juice containers need more frequent emptying

products.name: Hamilton Beach Big Mouth 800W Juicer (67702)
strengths: Easy to clean parts and included brush
limitations: Centrifugal design yields less from leafy greens

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
